problem: A user-provided Chrome export of Legends Barbary Apes contains one-pixel gray stock seams at x=5 and x=729 in a 732px image, plus a bottom edge. Live installed Chrome and WebKit reproduce them; bundled Chromium does not.
cause: The white plate and its recolored stock mask are composited at the same fractional bounds. Partial coverage at the second draw leaves some of the first white edge exposed.
correction: Fill stock outside and two canonical pixels inside the plate rectangle before applying the unmodified mask. Preserve the mask size, aperture, resampling and shared geometry. No source-asset edits or color-profile changes.

validation.note: Shared decoded sources are used for before/after. Installed Chrome and bundled Chromium interiors are byte-identical. WebKit has at most one-byte differences between separately prepared color materials; mask aperture tests are byte-identical.
